Bowel/Colo-rectal Surgery

Bowel preparation should be done for cases in which the colon should be cleansed

for surgical reasons.

Systemic antimicrobials should provide coverage for aerobes and anaerobes.

# Outpatient Orders for Bowel Prep Medications

[Outpatient orders for Bowel Prep \(Golytely+Neomycin PO+Erythromycin PO\)](psoz-set-general-surgery-bowel-prep)

# Inpatient Orders for Bowel Prep Medications

[Reglan 10mg PO prior to Golytely](psjz-metoclopramide-10mg-po-pre-golytely)

[Golytely Bowel Prep](psjz-golytely-bowel-prep)

[Neomycin 1000 mg PO TID day before surgery](psjz-neomycin-1gm-po-tid-bowel-prep)

[Erythromycin 1000 mg PO TID day before surgery](psjz-erythromycin-1gm-po-tid-bowel-prep)

# Systemic antimicrobials

# Preferred prophylaxis

[Cefazolin 2gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision](orz-set-abx-cefazo-wt-based-iv-metron-500mg-iv-preop)

($) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV over 30 minutes beginning 60

minutes before incision ($) [DI]

# Alternative in patient with beta lactam allergy

[Gentamicin 5 MG/KG  IV over 30 minutes \($\) R,O beginning 60 minutes](orz-set-abx-gentam-5-mg-kg-iv-30min-metro-500mg-iv-x1)

before incision <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV ($) [DI] over 30 minutes

beginning 60 minutes before incision

[Clindamycin 900mg IV over 30 minutes \($\)H,O beginning 60 minutes](orz-set-abx-clindamycin-900mg-iv-levofloxacin-500mg-iv)

before incision <AND> levofloxacin 500mg IV over 60 minutes ($)[R,DI]

beginning 60 minutes before incision.

References:

Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis

in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013, 70: 195-283

Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The

Medical Letter 2012, 10: 73-77

Sanford keyword: Prophylaxis
